name: url-shortener
description: A simple React + Vite web app that shortens long URLs using the Bitly API, with serverless functions powered by Netlify.

paragraphs: A small, editorial-style React web app that turns long URLs into short Bitly links. The frontend is a Vite + React + TypeScript SPA, styled with Tailwind CSS v4, and the backend is a single Netlify serverless function that proxies requests to the Bitly API.
Note: The deployed Netlify version of this app is currently paused, so the production URL may be unavailable.
features: Shorten long URLs through the Bitly API via a Netlify Function
Live, debounced validation — the submit button only enables once the input is a well-formed URL
Paste from clipboard — one click reads the clipboard into the input (with a confirmation toast)
Copy to clipboard — copy the resulting short link, with an auto-dismissing "Copied" toast
Friendly error handling — distinct client-side validation and server-side error states
